rocco.config.tip.swearing: How much bad language slips out.
rocco.config.tip.sarcasm: From a gentle wink to sharp irony.
rocco.config.tip.ego: How full of himself he is.
rocco.config.tip.dark_humor: Jokes about death and misfortune (always in the game).
rocco.config.tip.dark_side: His hidden psychopath, who now and then slips out against the game's mobs.
rocco.config.tip.jealousy: How he gets when something steals your attention.
rocco.config.tip.spontaneous: How often he says something when it's quiet.
rocco.config.tip.length: How much he talks in each reply.
rocco.config.tip.questions: How much he asks about your plans and tastes.
rocco.config.tip.facts: How many Minecraft fun facts he drops.
rocco.config.tip.life_advice: Now and then he tells you to drink water or take a break.
rocco.config.tip.fourth_wall: Whether he ever talks about the game as a game.
rocco.config.tip.impressions: Whether he imitates characters and celebrities when you ask. Applies to every mode.
rocco.config.tip.spontaneous_impressions: Whether he sometimes imitates someone without being asked.
rocco.config.tip.fears: Terrified of endermen, fire and the void.
rocco.config.tip.potato: Call him a potato and he gets indignant.
rocco.config.tip.trust_pace: How fast you become friends. The closer you are, the bolder he gets.
rocco.config.tip.dialect: How he talks. Automatic follows your game language. Applies to every mode.
rocco.config.tip.nickname: What he calls you sometimes. Empty: none. Applies to every mode.
rocco.config.tip.extra_notes: Anything you want to add to how he is (up to 800 letters). Never overrides his limits.

rocco.tutorial.title: Rocco Quick Guide
rocco.tutorial.page.1.title: Meet Rocco
rocco.tutorial.page.1.line.1: A miracle of nature: he sprouts from the ground, chats with a personality of his own and follows you everywhere: flying, swimming, by boat and on horseback.
rocco.tutorial.page.1.line.2: He works with no accounts or keys, using hundreds of built-in lines in Spanish. With a free AI key he really chats.
rocco.tutorial.page.1.tip: Use the ← and → keys to change page.
rocco.tutorial.page.2.title: Talking to him and calling him
rocco.tutorial.page.2.line.1: Type in chat near him, or talk by microphone (optional). Without an AI key he understands orders in Spanish, like "seguime" (follow me).
rocco.tutorial.page.2.line.2: If he gets lost, use /rocco llamar or set a key in Controls > Rocco: he shows up next to you.
rocco.tutorial.page.2.tip: If he dies, he comes back buried near you: right-click the mound.
rocco.tutorial.page.3.title: His menu
rocco.tutorial.page.3.line.1: Sneak + right-click opens his menu: what he is doing, how good friends you are, and buttons to follow, wait, sit, sleep or dance.
rocco.tutorial.page.3.line.2: You also save places for him to guide you to, and choose his gear and who he may attack.
rocco.tutorial.page.3.tip: In multiplayer, the menu is for the owner only.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.title: Storing your things
rocco.tutorial.page.4.line.1: Right-click Rocco to open his lid: 27 slots for your things.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.line.2: Say "guardá todo" (store everything) or "traeme carbón" (bring me coal). Ask "¿dónde guardaste?" and he tells you which chest.
rocco.tutorial.page.4.tip: What he is wearing (armor, weapon and shield) is never stored.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.title: Friendship and backpacks
rocco.tutorial.page.5.line.1: When you become friends he will give you a little seed: with it you craft his first backpack, and each backpack adds slots.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.line.2: Right-click him with the backpack to put it on. Upgrade it at a crafting table: its contents are kept.
rocco.tutorial.page.5.tip: The recipes appear in your book when he gives you the seed.
rocco.tutorial.page.6.title: Looking after the house
rocco.tutorial.page.6.line.1: Say "quedate cuidando la casa": he harvests and replants the garden and looks after the animals while you explore.
rocco.tutorial.page.6.line.2: When you are back he tells you what he did. To stop him, say "seguime" (follow me) or "vení" (come here).
rocco.tutorial.page.6.tip: He never touches named, leashed, ridden or tamed animals.
rocco.tutorial.page.7.title: Food, mate and gifts
rocco.tutorial.page.7.line.1: He eats and drinks potions to heal, and you can feed him by hand. Ask for a mate or "dame una Roco Cola", if you dare.
rocco.tutorial.page.7.line.2: If you were away for an hour or more, he leaves gifts in his lid. Now and then he gives you a strange thing he found.
rocco.tutorial.page.7.tip: To see this guide again: /rocco tutorial or the ? button in his menu.

rocco.tip.ai.provider: AUTO uses every provider that has a key, in the order of providerOrder, and jumps to the next if one fails. Pick a single one only to force it.
rocco.tip.ai.providerOrder: Order in which providers are tried with AUTO, separated by commas. custom goes first: if you pay for a better AI and set it up, that one is used. Options: custom, groq, gemini, openrouter, ollama.
rocco.tip.ai.offlineFallback: If no AI answers (or there are no keys), Rocco replies with his own lines and understands simple orders: plant, harvest, follow, wait, sleep...
rocco.tip.ai.localOrders: Saves AI: simple, clear orders (follow me, wait, sit, plant potatoes, store everything, craft me a pickaxe...) are solved by Rocco himself, without spending an AI request. Chat and anything that is not a clear order still goes to the AI. Off: everything goes through the AI.
rocco.tip.providers.groqApiKey: Groq: free and very fast. Key at console.groq.com/keys. If left empty, the environment variable ROCCO_GROQ_API_KEY is used.
rocco.tip.ai.geminiApiKey: Gemini key, free at aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. If left empty, the environment variable ROCCO_GEMINI_API_KEY is used.
rocco.tip.ai.geminiModel: Gemini model. 'auto' asks Google which ones exist today and picks the best flash available, so it does not break when Google retires models.
rocco.tip.providers.openrouterApiKey: OpenRouter: has free and paid models. Key at openrouter.ai/keys. If left empty, ROCCO_OPENROUTER_API_KEY is used.
rocco.tip.providers.openrouterModel: 'openrouter/free' picks among the free models of the moment. For a paid one, put its id (for example openai/..., meta-llama/...).
rocco.tip.providers.ollamaEnabled: Ollama runs the AI on your own PC: free, unlimited and offline, but it needs a decent graphics card. Download it at ollama.com.
rocco.tip.providers.ollamaUrl: Ollama address. By default it runs on your own PC.
rocco.tip.providers.ollamaModel: Ollama model, or 'auto' to use the first one you have installed.
rocco.tip.providers.customName: Your own provider, to use a better paid AI. Anything compatible with the OpenAI format works: OpenAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Together, LM Studio... This name is only used in messages.
rocco.tip.providers.customUrl: Base URL, ending in /v1. Examples: https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.deepseek.com/v1, https://api.mistral.ai/v1
rocco.tip.providers.customApiKey: Key of your own provider. If left empty, ROCCO_CUSTOM_API_KEY is used.
rocco.tip.providers.customModel: Model of your own provider (for example gpt-5-mini or deepseek-chat), or 'auto'.
rocco.tip.voice.enabled: If off, Rocco only writes and spends no voice credit.
rocco.tip.voice.recordedLines: Without a Fish Audio voice set up, his usual lines (the no-AI ones and the job ones) play with recordings that come with the mod, no key needed. If Fish Audio works, everything uses your voice and these are skipped, unless Fish Audio fails (no credit, no connection).
rocco.tip.voice.fishApiKey: Fish Audio key. If left empty, ROCCO_FISH_API_KEY is used.
rocco.tip.voice.voiceId: Fish Audio voice ID (the voice model's 'reference id'). It is the voice Rocco speaks with.
rocco.tip.audio.voiceVolume: Volume of Rocco's voice (on top of the "Voice/Speech" control in Options > Music & Sounds).
rocco.tip.audio.spatialAudio: The voice comes from where Rocco is, not from the center.
rocco.tip.voice.loudness: Volume at which the audio is generated.
rocco.tip.voice.sampleRate: Audio quality (samples per second). 24000 sounds good and is light; 44100 is CD quality. Fish Audio accepts: 8000, 16000, 24000, 32000, 44100.
rocco.tip.voice.latencyMode: NORMAL (Best quality): best quality. BALANCED: a bit faster. LOW (Fastest): answers sooner, with slightly less quality.
rocco.tip.personality.impressions: Rocco imitates voices and characters when you ask (and very rarely on his own). If off, he jokingly refuses: he only plays Rocco.
rocco.tip.voice.maxChars: Texts longer than this are not sent to be synthesized.
rocco.tip.voice.cacheEnabled: Saves spoken lines to disk and reuses them, so you do not pay twice for the same thing.
rocco.tip.voice.cacheSizeMb: Maximum size of that cache, in megabytes.
rocco.tip.voice.fishEndpoint: Base URL of the Fish Audio API.
rocco.tip.stt.enabled: Lets you talk to Rocco by microphone. The key (V by default) is changed in Options > Controls > Key Binds, category Rocco.
rocco.tip.stt.deepgramApiKey: Deepgram key. If left empty, ROCCO_DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is used.
rocco.tip.stt.language: Microphone language, as a short code: es, en, pt, multi...
rocco.tip.stt.activation: PUSH_TO_TALK (Hold key) records while you hold the key. VOICE_ACTIVATION (By voice): the key turns listening on or off, and while it is on it records by itself each time you talk and sends it when you stop.
rocco.tip.input.micDevice: Name of the microphone to use. Empty = the one Windows uses by default.
rocco.tip.stt.silenceTimeoutMs: Silence that ends the recording, in milliseconds. Only with VOICE_ACTIVATION (By voice).
rocco.tip.display.showMicIndicator: Shows an indicator while the microphone is recording.
rocco.tip.input.micFeedbackSound: A click plays when recording starts and ends.
rocco.tip.stt.deepgramEndpoint: Base URL of the Deepgram API.
rocco.tip.general.enabled: Turns Rocco completely on or off.
rocco.tip.display.showNameplate: Shows Rocco's name above his head.
rocco.tip.display.showArmor: Draws the armor Rocco is wearing.
rocco.tip.display.showHeldItems: Draws the weapon, shield and whatever Rocco holds.
rocco.tip.display.showHealth: Shows Rocco's hearts above his head while his health is not full.
rocco.tip.display.nameplateDistance: Maximum distance at which that name is seen.
rocco.tip.display.modelScale: Size at which Rocco is drawn. 1.0 is the original.
rocco.tip.behavior.censoredLid: What is inside his head when he opens the lid. AUTO: in Chill mode a little garden with flowers and butterflies, in the others the usual meat and goo. GARDEN: always the garden. CLASSIC: always the meat.
rocco.tip.chat.readPlayerChat: Rocco reads what you type in the game chat.
rocco.tip.chat.requireNameMention: Answers only if you name him. If off, he answers everything he hears.
rocco.tip.chat.hearingRadius: Distance in blocks from which he hears a player.
rocco.tip.chat.showInChat: Shows Rocco's text in chat, besides the voice.
rocco.tip.chat.maxResponseChars: Cuts answers longer than this, in characters.
rocco.tip.chat.historyTurns: Conversation turns he remembers in each request.
rocco.tip.chat.fullDetailTurns: Of those turns, how many go in full. The oldest ones are summarized, which speeds up the answer and makes the request cheaper.
rocco.tip.personality.dialect: How he talks. AUTO follows the player's game language. Applies to all three modes.
rocco.tip.personality.nickname: Nickname Rocco sometimes calls you. Empty = none.
rocco.tip.personality.moodEnabled: Adjusts the tone to the situation: at night, in a cave, with low health...
rocco.tip.personality.includeWorldContex: Tells him the time, weather, biome and dimension.
rocco.tip.personality.includeInventory: Tells him what you have in your inventory and in your hand.
rocco.tip.personality.includeNearbyEntit: Tells him which mobs and players are nearby.
rocco.tip.personality.includePlayerStats: Tells him your health, hunger and experience level.
rocco.tip.behavior.followStartDistance: From this distance he starts following you.
rocco.tip.behavior.followStopDistance: He stops when he reaches this distance. It must be smaller than the previous one.
rocco.tip.behavior.wanderRadius: While he follows you and you stand still, he wanders on his own up to this distance from you. When you move, he follows closely again.
rocco.tip.behavior.accompanyFlight: When you fly with an elytra (or in creative), he flies next to you with his leaves.
rocco.tip.behavior.accompanyWater: When you dive, he puts on goggles and dives with you. On the surface he always floats with his duck.
rocco.tip.behavior.accompanyBoat: When you go by boat, he goes along rowing his own little boat.
rocco.tip.behavior.accompanyHorse: When you ride a horse (saddled donkey or mule too), he climbs on in front of you.
rocco.tip.behavior.teleportDistance: If he is farther than this, he appears next to you. Also used when he gets stuck or stays in the water and cannot reach you. 0 turns teleporting off.
rocco.tip.behavior.leashBlocksTeleport: Tied to a post with a lead he does not appear next to you (nor fly, swim or row with you). To bring him anyway: /rocco llamar, which unties him.
rocco.tip.behavior.antiStuckEnabled: If he gets stuck unable to move (or stays swimming), he appears next to the player.
rocco.tip.behavior.antiStuckTicks: Ticks without moving before he counts as stuck.
rocco.tip.behavior.avoidWater: Avoids entering water when looking for a path.
rocco.tip.behavior.canOpenDoors: Can open wooden doors, fence gates and trapdoors to follow you.
rocco.tip.behavior.lookAtPlayer: Turns his head toward the nearest player.
rocco.tip.behavior.lookRadius: Maximum distance at which he looks at you.
rocco.tip.behavior.maxHealth: Rocco's maximum health. Applies when you re-enter the world.
rocco.tip.behavior.immortal: Rocco takes hits and complains, but never dies: he is left with half a heart, steps back behind you for a while and heals. /kill still works.
rocco.tip.behavior.invulnerable: Stronger than the above: he takes no damage at all, he does not even complain.
rocco.tip.behavior.deathMode: What happens if he dies. GRAVE: he drops his things and comes back buried next to where you respawn; dig him up with right click. PERMANENT: he dies for good.
rocco.tip.behavior.photosynthesisRegen: Heals by himself over time (photosynthesis): at half speed in the dark. Off: he only heals by eating, with potions or golden apples.
rocco.tip.behavior.regenSeconds: Seconds per half heart healed in the light (twice as long in the dark). After eating he heals twice as fast while the fullness lasts. He waits 5 s after each hit.
rocco.tip.behavior.defendOwner: Attacks whatever hurts you (respecting who you let him attack in his menu).
rocco.tip.behavior.assistOwner: Attacks whatever you attack (respecting who you let him attack in his menu).
rocco.tip.behavior.huntHostiles: Attacks monsters that come within 8 blocks of you, even if they have not hit you.
rocco.tip.behavior.attackCreepers: Fights creepers in melee. Off: he only shoots them if he has a bow or crossbow.
rocco.tip.behavior.ownerCanHurtRocco: Your hits hurt him, like any mob. Off: your hits do nothing to him (so you do not hurt him by accident in a fight).
rocco.tip.behavior.weaponDurability: His weapons and armor wear out like yours.
rocco.tip.behavior.defaultAttackHostiles: Who a new Rocco may attack (changed later in his menu): hostile mobs.
rocco.tip.behavior.defaultAttackPeaceful: Peaceful mobs: animals, villagers, golems, fish (also your pets).
rocco.tip.behavior.sleepWithPlayer: When you go to bed, Rocco sleeps too, and wakes up with you.
rocco.tip.behavior.idleSitEnabled: If you stay still for a while (at home, doing your things), he sometimes sits down.
rocco.tip.behavior.idleMateEnabled: If you stay still for a while, he sometimes has a mate on his own.
rocco.tip.behavior.idleMateCooldownMinut: Minimum minutes between one mate and the next when he has it on his own. If you ask, he has it anyway.
rocco.tip.behavior.idleDanceEnabled: If you stay still for a while, he sometimes starts dancing and humming.
rocco.tip.behavior.cheerEnabled: Celebrates your achievements: claps for the small ones (a common advancement, leveling up, taming an animal) and jumps with confetti for the big ones (bosses, challenges).
rocco.tip.behavior.colaIdleChance: Chance of having a Roco Cola each time he picks something to do in his free time.
rocco.tip.behavior.colaIdleCooldownMinut: Minimum minutes between two Roco Colas he has on his own.
rocco.tip.behavior.enderMessageToAll: The notice that he gained the ender chest power also reaches those nearby.
rocco.tip.behavior.musicEnabled: Rocco plays music when you give him a link ("Rocco, play this: https://..."). Each player hears it from their own game; the volume is the "Records" one.
rocco.tip.music.musicListen: Listen to the music Rocco plays (also what other players ask for). To hear it, your game opens the link: that site sees your connection.
rocco.tip.music.musicVolume: Volume of that music (on top of the "Records" control in Options > Music & Sounds).
rocco.tip.behavior.musicSing: While the music he put on plays, he sings and dances.
rocco.tip.music.musicBeatSync: Rocco sings and dances to the beat of the song (he works the rhythm out while it plays).
rocco.tip.behavior.musicDanceJukebox: If a record plays in a nearby jukebox, he goes and dances.
rocco.tip.behavior.returnGifts: If you were offline for at least an hour, when you come back he gives you what he collected: more and better things the longer you were away (the most, after a week).
rocco.tip.behavior.surprises: Every once in a while he gives you a strange little thing he found, or drops his diary. Also, if you ask for certain things as a joke, he answers with a small gift.
rocco.tip.work.searchRadius: How far he looks for chests, furnaces and crafting tables.
rocco.tip.work.waitForItemsSeconds: When materials are missing, how long he waits for you to hand them over before going to look in the chests around by himself.
rocco.tip.work.giveResultsToPlayer: What he crafts, cooks or fetches is handed to you (dropped nearby). If off, he keeps it in his inventory.
rocco.tip.work.pickUpGifts: Picks up what you drop near him (Q key). That is how you give him things. He only picks up what a player dropped, not what is lying around.
rocco.tip.work.gatherFromNature: If wood or stone is missing and there is none in the chests, he can chop a tree or mine stone around by himself. He never breaks buildings: only natural trees and terrain stone, dirt, sand or ores.
rocco.tip.work.protectEnchantedTools: He does not finish breaking enchanted tools: he leaves them at 1 durability so you can repair them.
rocco.tip.work.maxMiningSeconds: If breaking a block would take longer than this, he does not try.
rocco.tip.home.animalsPerSpecies: How many animals of each species he keeps around the home (babies included). He breeds them up to that number and no more.
rocco.tip.home.cullExtra: If a species has more adults than that, he slowly takes out the extra ones (and stores the meat and leather). He never touches named, leashed, ridden or tamed animals.
rocco.tip.home.shearSheep: Shears the sheep and stores the wool. If he has no shears, he makes them with 2 iron ingots he carries.
rocco.tip.home.useChestMaterials: To make shears he may use iron from the home's chests. Off: he only uses what he carries (or what you give him).
rocco.tip.home.keepHomeLoaded: While he looks after the home, that area stays loaded even if you go far: crops grow and animals move. Off: the home freezes when you are not near.
rocco.tip.magic.enchantCooldownMinutes: Minutes he has to rest after enchanting something. 20 is a whole Minecraft day. Counted with the game open, not real life.
rocco.tip.magic.enchantPower: How strongly he enchants, like the level of an enchanting table. 30 is the most of a table with every bookshelf.
rocco.tip.magic.allowTreasure: Can give treasure enchantments (Mending, Frost Walker...), which a normal table does not offer: they may come up at random, and can be chosen on request.
rocco.tip.ai.temperature: How much the answer varies. Low = predictable, high = creative. Only for Gemini 2.x models: ignored in 3.x (Google asks not to send it).
rocco.tip.ai.topP: Cumulative probability filter (nucleus sampling). Only for Gemini 2.x models: ignored in 3.x.
rocco.tip.ai.topK: Number of options considered per word. 0 turns it off. Only for Gemini 2.x models: ignored in 3.x.
rocco.tip.ai.maxOutputTokens: Maximum length of the answer, in tokens. In Gemini 3.x the reasoning tokens count against this limit: with less than 400 the answer may be cut before writing anything.
rocco.tip.ai.thinkingLevel: How much he reasons before answering. Lower = answers faster. Not every model accepts every level. If the model rejects the level, Rocco tries the next higher one. Only for Gemini 3.x models.
rocco.tip.ai.thinkingBudget: Tokens he may spend reasoning before answering. 0 = no reasoning, the fastest option for chatting. Only for Gemini 2.x models.
rocco.tip.ai.safetyLevel: Gemini content filters. OFF lets Rocco joke and insult playfully, which is part of his personality. With MEDIUM, Gemini 3.x may even block greetings: Rocco's cocky tone falls in the harassment category. Google keeps its basic protections anyway.
rocco.tip.ai.maxRetries: Retries when the request fails because of the network or a usage limit.
rocco.tip.ai.geminiEndpoint: Base URL of the API. Change it only if you know what you are doing.
rocco.tip.performance.maxConcurrentReque: Requests to the APIs in parallel.
rocco.tip.performance.rateLimitPerMinute: Cap of requests per minute. 0 turns it off.
rocco.tip.general.logRequestBodies: Logs the content sent to the APIs. Only for debugging: it can fill the log and never includes the keys.
rocco.tip.general.debugLogging: More detail in the log: length of the built prompt, blocked answers, dark side permissions. Also enables /rocco personalidad ver.
rocco.tip.behavior.ownerOnly: Only his owner gives him work orders (store, give, backpack, fight...) and opens his inventory. Other players nearby can chat with him but cannot command him or take his things. Off: any nearby player gives him orders.
